question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a 'Lagoon'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nainital**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nainital** is a popular hill station in the Indian state of Uttarakhand.
 
• It is known for its scenic beauty and the **Naini Lake**, which is a natural freshwater body.
 
• Nainital is **not a lagoon**; it is a natural lake situated in a mountainous region.
 
• **Lagoons** are shallow bodies of water separated from a larger body of water by barrier islands, reefs, or sandbanks.
 
• Examples of lagoons include **Chilika, Pulicat, and Kolleru**, which are coastal lagoons found in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lagoon**

 
 
• A lagoon is a shallow body of water separated from a larger sea by a barrier such as a sandbank, coral reef, or barrier island.
 
• Lagoons can be coastal (formed by the sea) or atoll (formed by coral reefs).
 
• They are typically found in coastal regions and can vary greatly in size.
 
• Examples of famous lagoons include the Venice Lagoon in Italy and the Blue Lagoon in Iceland.
 
 
 
• **Chilika Lake**
 
 
• Chilika Lake is the largest coastal lagoon in India and the second largest in the world.
 
• Located in the state of Odisha, it is known for its biodiversity, especially its bird population.
 
• It is a brackish water lagoon, meaning it has a mix of saltwater and freshwater.
 
 
 
• **Pulicat Lake**
 
 
• Pulicat Lake is the second largest brackish water lagoon in India.
 
• It is located on the border of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.
 
• The lagoon supports a variety of flora and fauna, including migratory birds.
 
 
 
• **Kolleru Lake**
 
 
• Kolleru Lake is one of the largest freshwater lakes in India, located in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Though primarily a freshwater lake, it can become brackish during certain seasons.
 
• The lake is a key habitat for various species of birds and fish.
